outcome_stated_first: FOR the paper on the S25-S26 correlation question; AGAINST the paper on the audit-coverage question

S25_S26_seed_overlap.S25_side: Moore neutral anchor arm ANCH (mud=0, 192x32, numgen 2e7) - all 1,556 shared runs; these ARE members of the S25 pooled neutral anchor (2,856) that normalises every re-anchored ridge
S25_S26_seed_overlap.geometry_note: different stencils (Moore vs von Neumann) and numgen; shared integer = shared RNG prefix only
S25_S26_seed_overlap.outcome_unit: T_fix percentile within each run's own ensemble arm (natural units)

permutation_test.scheme: shuffle S26 outcomes within arm (breaks seed pairing, preserves arm structure)

S25_S26_seed_overlap.verdict: rho = 0.02 (95% CI [-0.03, 0.07], permutation P = 0.48) is NOT inside the 0.29-0.48 band the paper characterises for other flagged pairs: it lies BELOW that band, i.e. weaker than 'at most weakly outcome-correlated'; no per-arm rho reaches 0.29 (max 0.19). The shared 12,900,000 seed block therefore carries no detectable outcome correlation between S25 and S26.

audit_coverage.reproduction_note: 54,355 reproduces exactly by applying the audit's own de-duplication to the 16 seeded, non-DERIVED tables among its 28 lineage-recorded inputs (raw 62,905 records; 8,550 exact-duplicate records removed). Two internal defects in seed_audit_global.json: (i) its embedded parquet_files dict lists only 13 of the 16 tables actually used (finite_size, intensivity_ext, neighbourhood_ridge, production_dfe, reduced_model_runs are missing from the dict yet ARE in the count), so the recorded script does not regenerate its own JSON (it yields 33,560); (ii) 'replicated_pool_records_excluded' says 6,950 but the true duplicate count under its own rule is 8,550; (iii) the three same-seed rho values (0.481/0.382/-0.008) are hard-coded literals in the script, not computed there.

decomposition.note: category totals A + A_dup + B + C = 135,999 checksum ledger ROWS; distinct-simulation count removes the two whole double-booked rows (A_dup = 3,100) AND the 150-run partial overlap inside category A (tfix neutral runs re-deposited in the Bd row): 135,999 - 3,250 = 132,749

audit_coverage.distinct_run_ledger_note: the 135,999 headline double-books 3,250 runs vs distinct simulations: the 4c tail-ensemble row (1,600) is re-deposited inside bd_results (source=tail_ensemble_reuse); S5 (1,500) is the exp-2 arm of the 2a-c tfix row (4,250); and 150 neutral T_fix runs (bd source=tfix_neutral_reuse) sit in BOTH the 2a-c row and the Bd row (a partial overlap inside category A). Distinct simulations = 135,999 - 3,250 = 132,749. Minor: S19 pilot arm deposits 94 runs against a stated 96 (aspect row 1,029 vs 1,027 resolvable).
